source.title: The War Within Pre-Expansion Content Update Notes
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

notes: Dragonflight-era Inspiration profession stat was removed in the The War Within pre-expansion update. Historical Inspiration-era prospecting and milling observations should retain their patch context; no numeric change magnitude is claimed.
affects: Dragonflight profession Inspiration mechanics and other profession crafting
wording: Inspiration has been removed and replaced by Concentration and Ingenuity.
